Fortunately for you, both she and Kirita has an idea on how they can relieve your masochistic urges while also solving another one of their worries, Hinata. As it turns out, Hinata has been depressed recently because she lost interest in her only source of stress relief, so she has no way to release her pent-up stress for her grueling studies, fortunately for her, Kirita and Yuna has the perfect stress relief option for her, a human punching bag.
